subtitle.en: Smart Agriculture Companion with AI & Satellite Integration
subtitle.id: Pendamping Pertanian Cerdas dengan Integrasi AI & Satelit

overview.en: Indonesia is an agrarian nation, yet farmers still rely on generational experience to face modern challenges: unpredictable weather, elusive pests, and volatile market prices. Extension workers exist but can't be everywhere. TUNAS is the 'always-there' extension worker - a digital companion empowering farmers with satellite monitoring, AI diagnostics, and direct market access.
overview.id: Indonesia adalah negara agraris, namun petani masih mengandalkan pengalaman turun-temurun untuk menghadapi tantangan modern: cuaca tak terduga, hama yang sulit dideteksi, dan fluktuasi harga pasar. Penyuluh pertanian ada tetapi tidak bisa menjangkau setiap petani di setiap lahan. TUNAS adalah 'penyuluh yang selalu ada' - pendamping digital yang memberdayakan petani dengan pemantauan satelit, diagnostik AI, dan akses pasar langsung.

problem_statement.en: Smallholder farmers struggle with three critical gaps: 1) Lack of real-time data on land conditions (soil moisture, weather), 2) Difficulty identifying pests/diseases leading to crop loss, 3) Isolation from market information and peer knowledge. Traditional methods result in significant yield losses and economic vulnerability.
problem_statement.id: Petani kecil berjuang dengan tiga kesenjangan kritis: 1) Kurangnya data real-time tentang kondisi lahan (kelembaban tanah, cuaca), 2) Kesulitan mengidentifikasi hama/penyakit yang menyebabkan gagal panen, 3) Terisolasi dari informasi pasar dan pengetahuan sebaya. Metode tradisional mengakibatkan kerugian hasil panen yang signifikan dan kerentanan ekonomi.

target_user.name: Jerry Jerricho
goals: Increase harvest yield with modern tech
Find quick solutions for pest problems
Share and learn from other farmers
pain_points: Hard to identify pest types and treatments
Minimal access to trusted agricultural info
Lack of active digital farmer community

principles_applied.application: Large, easily reachable buttons in bottom navigation bar for one-thumb operation in the field.
Simplified menu structure to reduce decision fatigue; key features visible on home screen without deep nesting.
Critical data (weather, soil status) highlighted with size and color contrast for instant recognition.

key_features.name: Satellite Land Monitoring
key_features.description: Real-time view of land conditions via satellite imagery, including temperature, humidity, light levels, weather forecasts, and harvest estimates. AI analyzes crop health and suggests actionable recommendations.

key_features.name: AI Pest Assistant
key_features.description: Snap a photo of affected plants → AI instantly identifies pest/disease type, provides diagnosis, and recommends specific products available in TUNAS Market.

key_features.name: Smart Chat AI
key_features.description: Beyond a chatbot: an intelligent assistant for farming queries (fertilizer timing, weather, market prices) with natural language understanding.

key_features.name: Global Community Forum
key_features.description: Connect with farmers locally and internationally. Auto-translation breaks language barriers. Anonymous reporting system maintains community safety and trust.

key_features.name: TUNAS Market
key_features.description: Direct buying/selling platform for seeds, fertilizers, tools, and harvests. Includes market analytics, commodity price checks, and store creation for users.

key_features.name: Gamified Education Hub
key_features.description: Interactive video modules on farming techniques. Earn rare badges upon completion to showcase in the community profile.

outcome.en: Won 2nd Place at GENETIC 2025 for innovative fusion of AI, satellite tech, and community-driven design. The prototype demonstrated a clear path to reducing crop loss by 30% and increasing farmer income through direct market access. Validated that accessible, minimal-interface design is crucial for adoption among non-tech-savvy users.
outcome.id: Menang Juara 2 di GENETIC 2025 atas inovasi penggabungan AI, teknologi satelit, dan desain berbasis komunitas. Prototipe menunjukkan jalur jelas untuk mengurangi kehilangan hasil panen hingga 30% dan meningkatkan pendapatan petani melalui akses pasar langsung. Tervalidasi bahwa desain antarmuka minimalis yang mudah diakses sangat penting untuk adopsi oleh pengguna non-teknis.
